name: Sinomach Automobile Co.,Ltd.
summary: Sinomach Automobile Co.,Ltd. provides automotive engineering systems services in China. The company offers engineering systems services, automobile distribution services, and car rental services, as well as automotive welding, painting, final assembly, casting and forging, logistics, and digital and intelligent operations. It also provides certification assistance, customs clearance, warehousing, logistics, and distribution; port and logistics services; export trade services; project management services; engineering supervision services; testing services; and park management services. In addition, the company is involved in automobile and spare parts wholesale; car rental; engineering design…
